senses.gloss:
झिरी f. (-री) A cricket.
 E. झि imitative of the cricket's chirp, रा to
make, affixes ड and ङीष्: also झिल्ली; भिरिका, and (कन् being add
ed); also इ pen. being made long झिरीका, or changed to उ, झिरुका
the first vowel also being lengthened झीरिका, and झीरुका, &c.
झिरिति अव्यक्तशब्दोऽस्ति अस्या इन् ।
झिरुका f. (-का) A cricket: see the last.
झीरुका f. (-का) A cricket: see झिरी.
झीरिका f. (-का A cricket: see झिरी.
